Short titile and commencement

THE SINDH EMERGENCY PROCUREMENT ACT, 2014
THE SINDH EMERGENCY
PROCUREMENT ACT, 2014
SINDH
ACT NO. II OF 2014
KARACHI,
THE 26TH FEBRUARY, 2014.
AN
ACT
NO.PAS/Legis-B-03/2014--The
Sindh Emergency Procurement Bill, 2014 having been
passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 7th
February 2014 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 20th February, 2014 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh. to
make provision for emergency procurement for the law enforcement agency in the Province of Sindh.
Preamble: WHEREAS it is
expedient to make provision for emergency procurement for the law enforcement
agency in the Province of Sindh, in the wake of
targeted attacks and threats to the law enforcement agency and people of
Province which has resulted into the loss of precious human lives and the
properties including personnel of law enforcement agency;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
1. Short titile
and commencement----(1)
This Act may be called the Sindh Emergency
Procurement Act, 2014.
(2)
It shall extend to the whole of the Province
of Sindh;
(3)
It shall come into force at once and shall remain in force for one year from
the date of its commencement.

Definitions

Preamble: WHEREAS it is
expedient to make provision for emergency procurement for the law enforcement

targeted attacks and threats to the law enforcement agency and people of
Province which has resulted into the loss of precious human lives and the
properties including personnel of law enforcement agency;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
2. Definitions----In this
Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context -
(a) emergency procurement means the procurement made on urgent
basis for the security and protection of the personnel of law enforcement
agency and people of the Province;
(b) law
enforcement agency means the Sindh Police, Sindh Prisons Police, Pakistan Rangers and Frontier
Constabulary deployed in the Province
of Sindh.

Preamble: WHEREAS it is
expedient to make provision for emergency procurement for the law enforcement
agency in the Province of Sindh, in the wake of
targeted attacks and threats to the law enforcement agency and people of
Province which has resulted into the loss of precious human lives and the
properties including personnel of law enforcement agency;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
3. Emergency Procurement---Notwithstanding anything contained in
the Sindh Public Procurement Regulatory Authority
Act, 2009 or rules made thereunder or any other law
for the time being in force and the procedure of procurement laid
down hereunder, the emergency procurement shall be made by the law enforcement
agency on urgent basis.

It is hereby
enacted as follows:-
4. Items to be procured in an emergency---The emergency procurement shall be made for the items, which
relate to the security and protection of the personnel of law enforcement
agency and people of the Province, such as armored personnel carrier bomb
proof, bullet proof jackets, bullet proof helmets and bullet proof vehicles,
arms and ammunitions of all types and any other related equipment.
